inputs.text: [excited] TIE… tan… oh… SOR. [curious] "Titan," in Greek, means the Titans — giants from old Greek stories, bigger than anything.

[amazed] That's it. And not just any giant: [proud] one of the biggest animals that ever walked on Earth. It lived in Argentina, [amazed] in Patagonia, a hundred million years ago, [pauses] and once grown, its size protected it from hunters like Tyrannotitan.
